run_log_regression_eval: run DINOv2 logistic regression evaluation on ImageNet using cuML with frozen features
create_LogRegModule: create a cuML-based logistic regression module with L2 penalty for frozen feature classification
sweep_C_values: sweep regularization C values across a range to find the best hyperparameter for log regression
eval_log_regression_with_model: evaluate a DINOv2 model using logistic regression on train, val, and finetune datasets
train_for_C: train a logistic regression model with a specific C regularization value on extracted features
